existing_rows_audit.detail: Chicago HQ confirmed (175 W. Jackson Blvd, Suite 200, https://www.wolve.com/contact) and a C++ role is genuinely open, but the exact posted title is 'C++ Software Engineer' (https://careers.wolve.com/en/jobs/455116), described as a 'Low-Level C++ Software Engineer' on ultra-low-latency trading systems. existing_rows_audit.existing_title: Software Engineer — comp figure '$220–300k' / USD mid 260
existing_rows_audit.detail: The live 'C++ Software Engineer' posting states verbatim: 'The base compensation range for this role is approximately $100,000-$140,000 contingent on experience. Wolverine Trading's total compensation model includes base salary and an annual discretionary bonus.' (https://careers.wolve.com/en/jobs/455116). The sheet's $220-300k year-1 total-comp estimate is not supported by anything Wolverine states; the stated base is roughly half the sheet's low end. Treat the existing figure as unverified extrapolation.

notes:
ZERO in-scope openings. Wolverine's careers site (https://www.wolve.com/open-positions) is a JS-only shell backed by a Pinpoint ATS at careers.wolve.com; I pulled the board's JSON API (https://careers.wolve.com/jobs.json?per_page=200 and /postings.json?per_page=200) rather than guessing at the rendered page. Every single live req -- 11 in jobs.json, 14 in postings.json -- is located in Chicago, IL. Titles seen: C++ Software Engineer; C++ Software Engineer - Latency-Critical Systems; Software Engineer - Trading Systems; Software Engineer - N-Tiered Software Developer; C# Software Engineer; FPGA Engineer; Systematic Options Trader; Quantitative Trader - High Frequency Futures; Electronic Options Trader; Quantitative Trading Analyst; Business Intelligence Engineer; Information Systems Manager; Floor Brokerage Clerk; Recruiting Coordinator. Several of these would be strong track matches (C++, Trader, Research) if the candidate were US-authorised, but Chicago is out of scope for this pass and the candidate has no US work authorisation.

OFFICE VERIFICATION. London: CONFIRMED as a real proprietary-trading entity, not just a mailbox. Wolverine's own site footer links a 'Wolverine Trading UK' MIFIDPRU 8 Disclosure (https://www.wolve.com/Content/pdf/MIFIDPRU%208%20Disclosure%20Statement%2006-2026.pdf, dated June 2026), which states Wolverine Trading UK Limited is UK-incorporated under company number 03770429, FCA-authorised since 2001 under FRN 190655, a non-SNI MIFIDPRU Investment Firm that 'conducts a proprietary trading operation', engaging in market making and valuation arbitrage, dealing for its own account in futures/options/derivatives, exchange-traded only. Companies House confirms company 03770429 is Active with registered office 1 New Street, 4th Floor, London, EC2M 4TP (https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/03770429). The disclosure gives own funds of GBP 7,315,988 -- a small entity, consistent with a modest London headcount. Note: several aggregators (highperformr, clutch) claim the London office is at CityPoint, One Ropemaker Street, EC2Y 9HT; that conflicts with Companies House and I did not treat it as reliable.

Despite the confirmed London entity, there are currently NO London openings on Wolverine's own board. A 'Trading Application Support - London, UK' listing appears on the aggregator thatstartupjob.com but (a) it does not exist on Wolverine's own ATS, so it is stale or never was on the public board, and (b) it is IT/application support -- out of scope for all four tracks anyway. It also specifies 1:00am-9:00am Central coverage hours. I did not add it.

Asia: found NO evidence Wolverine Trading the prop firm has any Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo or Shanghai office. Searches surface a 'Wolverine Trading (HK) Limited' in Hong Kong company/import-export directories (volza.com, 996co.com), but nothing links it to the Chicago prop firm and the trade-data context suggests an unrelated import/export company with a coincidental name -- I deliberately did not record it as an office. Wolverine's own materials only ever reference Chicago, New York, San Francisco and the UK affiliate.

BLOCKERS: the FCA public register page rendered as a JS/CSS error under WebFetch and could not be read; I substituted Companies House plus Wolverine's own MIFIDPRU disclosure, which together establish the same facts. wolve.com's /about, /about-us, /locations and /our-firm paths do not exist or contain no location list -- the firm publishes no offices page, so office confirmation had to come from the regulatory trail.

BOTTOM LINE FOR THE CANDIDATE: Wolverine is effectively a Chicago-only employer for the tracks in scope. The London entity is real but tiny and appears to be a trading/support outpost rather than a hiring engineering or research centre; no in-scope req was live as of 2026-08-04. Worth a low-priority watch on https://careers.wolve.com/ (or registering interest at https://wolve.pinpointhq.com/en/register-your-interest/new) rather than active pursuit.
